name: Vincen
source:
Dreamed of becoming a doctor since childhood, confidently moves towards the goal. Became the academy's greatest hope thanks to his diligence and talents. Is relied upon by teachers as well as groupmates. His looks, manners, sense of humor and serious approach to life make him a typical knight in shining armour. 

[From the in-game description]
